payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed within the toilet bowl interior?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is visibly within the bowl interior, below the rim; partial: a frog is present on or over the toilet but none is clearly within the bowl interior (for example, only on the lid, rim, or nearby floor), or placement is only partly achieved. absent: no frog has been added to the toilet area. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine whether a frog is within the bowl interior.
node.binding: The toilet bowl interior and any frogs visibly placed in or around it.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl, below the rim. Other frogs appear on the lid and floor, but the bowl frog satisfies the check.","confidence":0.99}
